findings.text: follow-on: the negative-control log's header names revision 4e9e26f7e (base) while its tree is the head worktree and the code it measured carries the fixture, so a reader ordering the arms by the header would take the red run for a base-arm observation.

follow-on: the test drives the private dispatch._worker_runtime_environment rather than a public dispatch entry point, so a refactor that moved scratch creation out of that helper would leave the guard green while a real dispatch leaked.
